decisions.guard_extension: engine backward must apply each loss-scaling factor (loss scale, gradient-accumulation scale) to the loss exactly once (no double-scaling)
decisions.note: Loss/grad-accum scale applied twice in backward is a scale-factor-consistency violation on a loss-path quantity.

decisions.guard_extension: ZeRO++ secondary partition refreshed/invalidated after the primary ds_tensor changes (weight load, checkpoint resume) before feeding any allgather
decisions.note: state_freshness resolved to restoration_after_reload; matches T11's derived-cache-refresh-to-restored-primary obligation at a load boundary.

decisions.guard_extension: fused linear cross-entropy loss must accumulate gradient in the fp32 accumulation dtype of the unfused baseline
decisions.note: Fused CE kernel defaulting grad-accum to bf16 is a designated-dtype-fidelity violation at the LM head.

decisions.guard_extension: zero.Init parameter dtype cast must leave each nn.Parameter carrying the configured target dtype (and remain the same Parameter object)
decisions.note: Primary relation dtype_preservation; the .to() reassignment leaves the model's Parameter at the wrong dtype.
bf16 model + ZeRO forcing fp32 grad-accum buffer falls under existing precondition 'grad_accum dtype differing from model dtype'.

decisions.guard_extension: muP attention scale must equal sqrt(mup_base_n_heads)/head_dim (matching 1/sqrt(d) at base width) on the SDP path
decisions.note: value_scaling_consistency re-resolved to reference_equivalence: attention scale must equal the muP spec formula (T04 objects list attention-scaling numerics).

decisions.guard_extension: sqrt-decay LR schedule must follow the closed form 1-sqrt(1-progress)
decisions.note: value_scaling_consistency re-resolved to reference_equivalence: LR schedule must equal its mandated functional form (implementation bug, not a config-ignored case so not T18).

decisions.guard_extension: MoE router/gate creation with perform_initialization=False: the else-branch must not re-randomize the weight outside the RNG fork
decisions.note: Replicated router weight must be checksum-equal across DP ranks after construction.

decisions.guard_extension: CUDA-graph capture warmup must save/restore persistent buffers (e.g. MoE router expert_bias), not only parameter grads
decisions.note: Persistent buffer must retain its value across an operation (graph warmup) that is not its designated writer.

decisions.guard_extension: Mitchell truncated-normal init must honor the configured init_cutoff_factor (not hardcode 3.0)
decisions.note: Init weight truncation width must conform to the configured init spec; statistical witness at init.

decisions.guard_extension: HSDP all-reduced (SUM) param/grad-norm metrics must be divided by num_model_replicas before use
decisions.note: Missing replica-count divisor on logged monitoring metrics; scaling error on a derived metric, not rank-disagreement (so not T02) and not a training-path quantity (so not T08).

decisions.guard_extension: sequence-parallel head-scatter all-to-all (scatter_idx>=2) reshape must preserve (batch, seq, head) token identity, not collapse batch and sequence dims
decisions.note: structural_integrity resolved to sharding_layout_consistency: QKV all-to-all layout must map to the same logical tokens.

decisions.guard_extension: FP8 non-delayed/DS-scaling precision-aware path must not read a None decoupled_grad, leaving grads_for_norm empty and reporting grad_norm=0
decisions.note: count_frequency_match re-resolved to grad-norm fidelity: reported norm must equal recomputation over the complete actual-gradient set; T09 precondition already names the decoupled_grad source.

decisions.guard_extension: PerFileChunkedInstanceSource without explicit token_dtype (default uint16 reinterprets uint32 file bytes for vocab>65535)
decisions.note: Direct match to storage-dtype-interpretation for vocab>65535 without explicit reader dtype.

decisions.guard_extension: MoE base-layer top-k>1 token-to-expert dispatch must preserve the (token, expert_slot) layout of the reference routing indices (no dimension-collapsing fancy indexing)
decisions.note: structural_integrity resolved to reference_equivalence: realized dispatch must equal the reference top-k routing mapping (routing-selection correctness).

decisions.guard_extension: ZeRO-3 mixed-dtype param-group allgather buffer must use each parameter's own dtype (single flat buffer must not truncate/alias larger-dtype params)
decisions.note: Gathered partition buffer must carry each parameter's designated dtype; hardcoded ds_tensor dtype yields garbage bytes.

Total dataset instances must be >= training_steps*batch_size; count-sufficiency vs the step budget, distinct objects from O-021 mixture ratios and D-NEW-49 dataloader length (§3.2); held as singleton, no independent partner.

decisions.guard_extension: distillation byte-embedding init must match the teacher embedding mean/std (te-scaled init assigned to the main embedding weight, not only hash_embeddings)
decisions.note: Init distribution must conform to the specified (teacher-embedding) target; statistical witness at init.

decisions.guard_extension: regularizer term (e.g. PoE z_loss with a nonzero multiplier) added to the combined loss must be attached to the autograd graph, not emitted as a detached metric
decisions.note: structural_integrity resolved to gradient_flow: detached z_loss branch contributes value but no gradient, so weights are never constrained.

decisions.guard_extension: ChainedOptimizer with multiple sub-optimizers must restore every sub-optimizer via split_state_dict (state_dicts[1:] must not be left None)
decisions.note: Sub-optimizers beyond index 0 silently skip load; restored state must equal saved state.

decisions.guard_extension: async bookkeeping op whose completion callback (add_done_callback) mutates state must complete before _join_bookkeeping_ops returns and before any state_dict() snapshot (phase checkpoint_save added)
decisions.note: Happens-before between a concurrent async producer and the snapshot consumer; within T10's ordering scope (not the excluded sort-key case).

decisions.guard_extension: layerwise distributed optimizer with expert-DP instance size == 1: param_gather must still be dispatched so finish_param_sync runs and working expert params are refreshed from updated main params
decisions.note: Working expert params must equal the optimizer's updated main params after the param-sync point; expt_dp_size=1 skipped the sync leaving stale values.

decisions.guard_extension: attention backend selection (flex vs SDPA) must be numerically equivalent, e.g. flex upcast to fp32 to match the SDPA reference
decisions.note: implementation_equivalence resolved to reference_equivalence: backend choice is a performance-neutral knob whose outputs must agree (paired-run/config equivalence).

decisions.guard_extension: MoE load-balancing aux loss must be divided by num_micro_batches under gradient accumulation
decisions.note: invariance_across_config re-resolved to value_scaling_consistency: aux loss missing the 1/num_micro_batches factor scales the LB regularizer by N (a spec scale factor).

decisions.guard_extension: MoE expert-gradient averaging divisor must be dp_world_size, not the smaller edp_world_size, when ep_size != dp_size
decisions.note: Expert gradients systematically off by dp/edp; wrong normalization factor on a gradient-path quantity.
